::: {#stepup .project-card .featured data-topics="movement eeg gait"}
[Parkinson's disease · Mobile EEG · Gait]{.kicker}

### [StepuP](stepup.qmd){.stretched} {#h-stepup}

Multicentre randomised controlled trial (JPND) on the mechanisms of speed-dependent treadmill training in Parkinson's disease, with synchronised EEG, EMG and motion capture. Kiel site lead; responsible for the consortium's multimodal recording and data pipeline.

[JPND · 2023–2026 · shared first author of the protocol]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#metarep .project-card .featured data-topics="meta eeg open"}
[Meta-science · Mobile EEG]{.kicker}

### [META-REP](meta-rep.qmd){.stretched} {#h-metarep}

Analysis of preprocessing and reporting practices in mobile EEG studies within the DFG Priority Programme META-REP, and development of a reporting standard for mobile EEG.

[DFG · SPP 2317 · Oldenburg]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#igor .project-card data-topics="open meta"}
[Open science · Community]{.kicker}

### [IGOR](igor.qmd){.stretched} {#h-igor}

Interest Group on Open and Reproducible Research of the DGPs section Biological Psychology and Neuropsychology. BIDS Consultation Hour; co-lead of an umbrella review on EEG/ERP preprocessing.

[DGPs · since 2020]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#eegmanysteps .project-card data-topics="eeg gait open meta"}
[Mobile EEG · Multi-lab]{.kicker}

### [EEGManySteps](eegmanysteps.qmd){.stretched} {#h-eegmanysteps}

Community initiative that collects and harmonises gait EEG recorded with different setups to quantify the influence of hardware, recording protocols and pipelines. Steering committee member.

[Community · since 2024]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#motion-bids .project-card data-topics="tools open gait"}
[Data standard]{.kicker}

### [Motion-BIDS](https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/modality-specific-files/motion.html){.stretched} {#h-motion-bids}

Extension of the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) for motion data from optical motion capture and inertial sensors (BEP029). Co-lead.

[BIDS · Scientific Data 2024]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#kielmat .project-card data-topics="tools gait movement"}
[Software · Python]{.kicker}

### [KielMAT](../software/index.qmd#kielmat){.stretched} {#h-kielmat}

Kiel Motion Analysis Toolbox (formerly NGMT): Python toolbox with validated gait and balance algorithms for wearable and motion-capture data from neurological cohorts.

[Neurogeriatrics Kiel · JOSS 2024]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#unisep .project-card data-topics="tools open"}
[Data standard]{.kicker}

### [UNISEP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.21159){.stretched} {#h-unisep}

Modality-independent framework for describing sensor placement on the human body in motion capture and wearable research.

[Preprint · 2024 · co-first author]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#redcap .project-card data-topics="tools open"}
[Software · Clinical data]{.kicker}

### [rcol](../software/index.qmd#rcol){.stretched} {#h-redcap}

Python package with templates for standardised questionnaires and clinical tests in REDCap.

[Python · since 2025]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#pocketable .project-card data-topics="eeg tools"}
[Mobile EEG · Smartphones]{.kicker}

### [Pocketable MoBI](https://neuropsyol.github.io/){.stretched} {#h-pocketable}

Smartphone-based recording of mobile EEG and body movement, developed in the Oldenburg Neuropsychology Lab.

[Oldenburg · 2024–2026]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#epoc .project-card data-topics="eeg"}
[EEG · Post-COVID]{.kicker}

### [EPOC](https://github.com/christianneumannCAU/EPOC-Kiel){.stretched} {#h-epoc}

EEG correlates of fatigue and subjective cognitive complaints after COVID-19. Co-supervision.

[Kiel · ongoing]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#electrodes .project-card data-topics="eeg tools"}
[EEG · Computer vision]{.kicker}

### [Electrode localisation from video](https://github.com/evrim06/video-eeg-electrode-registration){.stretched} {#h-electrodes}

Open-source pipeline for 3D EEG electrode localisation from smartphone video.

[Oldenburg · 2025–2026]{.card-meta}
:::

:::

## Completed projects

::: {.card-grid}

::: {#tremordetect .project-card data-topics="movement tools"}
[Essential tremor]{.kicker}

### [Tremor assessment](https://github.com/JuliusWelzel/tremor_feedback_jw){.stretched} {#h-tremordetect}

Effects of sensory feedback and arousal on action tremor, and validity of tremor analysis with smartphone-compatible computer vision (MediaPipe).

[Kiel · 2021–2025]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#comon .project-card data-topics="gait movement"}
[Neurogeriatrics]{.kicker}

### ComOn {#h-comon}

Exploratory multicentre study of motor, cognitive and mobility deficits in geriatric patients before and after routine clinical treatment.

[UKSH · 2017–2023]{.card-meta}
:::

::: {#senseage .project-card data-topics="eeg"}
[EEG · Ageing]{.kicker}

### Sense-Age {#h-senseage}

EEG and behavioural measures of selective and sustained attention in ageing and cognitive impairment.

[EEG lab, UKSH]{.card-meta}
:::
